summary: Unnamed client who came in with a temporarily restricted/shadowbanned Instagram account (347-day restriction) and asked about pricing for recommendation-issue fixes and unshadowban work, ideally without needing login credentials. He was budget-constrained in mid-July, was working through password/login access and had to remove some linked Meta accounts, and had an appeal pending. On 2026-07-29 he resurfaced asking about "Kartik" — a mutual the owner had just cut off — and mentioned he had referred several friends that day who hadn't paid yet. Active referral source; worth following up on both his own unshadowban job and the unpaid referrals.
key_facts: Instagram account under a temporary restriction listing 347 days, not a full ban
Asked cost to fix recommendation/shadowban issue; no price was quoted in the thread
Wanted to know if unshadowban was possible without providing login — initially thought no login was needed
Said budget was 'mad low' in July; was sorting out password access and removed some Meta accounts
Had an appeal pending and asked how long appeal removal takes
Referred multiple friends on 2026-07-29 — none had paid yet at time of messaging
Knows 'Kartik', a client the owner dropped for being too high-maintenance
